label: Steel Workshop
description: Cool off-white with a steel-teal primary, deep gunmetal bands and a burnt-orange accent. Built for fabricators and steel furniture makers, whose photography is bright metal shot under workshop lights — a dark theme swallows it, and plain white makes powder-coated teal and green look accidental.
notes: Primary is taken from the powder-coat teal that recurs across this trade's own work (counters, display cabinets, almirahs) so the site and the products agree instead of competing. Every pairing clears WCAG AA: text/bg 15.51:1, muted/bg 5.80:1, primary/bg 5.70:1, accent/bg 5.57:1, white/primary 6.07:1, white/secondary 12.82:1. Accent was darkened from a natural burnt orange (#B45309, 4.71:1) because SiteRenderer paints 12px meta text in it, which is where a theme normally fails. `secondary` is a dark BAND colour, not a text colour — measure text on it, never it against bg. Small radius on purpose: rounded corners read as soft furnishing, square reads as fabricated steel. Barlow Condensed gives the headings an industrial signage feel while Inter keeps body copy plain.
